diseases.name: Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis)
diseases.description: Atopic dermatitis is a chronic inflammatory skin condition characterized by dry, itchy, and inflamed patches of skin.
causes: Genetics and skin barrier dysfunction (filaggrin deficiency)
Environmental allergens and irritants (soaps, detergents, wool)
general_care: Apply thick ceramide moisturizers within 3 minutes after lukewarm bathing
Use fragrance-free, gentle hypoallergenic soap substitutes
Avoid scratching by keeping fingernails trimmed and using cool compresses
diseases.medical_attention: Seek medical attention if lesions become oozing, crusting with yellow pus (signs of secondary bacterial infection), or if severe flare-ups do not respond to OTC moisturizers.

diseases.name: Acne Vulgaris
diseases.description: A very common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil, dead skin cells, and Cutibacterium acnes bacteria.
causes: Excess sebum (oil) production driven by androgens
Cutibacterium acnes bacterial proliferation and localized inflammation
general_care: Wash skin gently twice daily with a mild, non-comedogenic foaming cleanser
Avoid picking, squeezing, or popping pimples to prevent scarring and hyperpigmentation
Always use oil-free (non-comedogenic) moisturizers and broad-spectrum sunscreens
diseases.medical_attention: Consult a dermatologist if you experience deep, painful cystic or nodular acne, or if OTC treatments fail after 8-12 weeks.
